$comment: Provenance for this package, which is a copy of a country configuration repository maintained outside core. Update lastPorted whenever changes are brought across, and record a `Ported-from: <sha> (<repo>)` trailer on each commit that does so.

source.$comment: A downstream fork of opencrvs-countryconfig: its release branches merge countryconfig's, so a port here layers testland-specific work on top of whatever countryconfig-template received. Port countryconfig-template first. The repository was previously named opencrvs-farajaland.

seededFrom.$comment: Recorded in the import commit message: 'imported from opencrvs/opencrvs-farajaland @ 7c9d071'. Note this revision is on develop and is NOT an ancestor of release/2.0.1; the two diverged at 46c99fda6.

procedure: 1. Candidate set: `git log --no-merges origin/develop..<release-branch>` in the source repo, NOT a diff against seededFrom. A release branch also carries content reverted on develop, so a directional tree diff reports those reversions as changes to port. Restricting to commits absent from develop excludes them by construction.
2. Classify every candidate: already in core (landed independently), not applicable to this version, or genuine. Check core for the change itself, not for the commit.

3. Apply genuine commits with `git -C <source> format-patch <sha> -1 --stdout -- src | git apply --directory=packages/<pkg> -3`, one core commit each, keeping the original message and adding a Ported-from trailer. Hand-write the commit where core has diverged.
4. Update lastPorted above, then run typecheck, lint and tests for the package.
